items.body:
I was looking at this recently too with our inconsistent use of tooltips on interactive states on icon-buttons that are placed inside other components.

This brings up a question I have for the devs around what color tokens we are using for these instances of the icon button, since they are placed on a `$field` input background. Would our layering logic work for these buttons, if this input for example was using `$field-02`? Need to investigate this more. I feel like we might need a `$field-active` color token if we are applying field tokens for the icon button that sits on inputs so it will work in different layering situations.
Just went through our UIs and found this to be a really bad UX. Check this out: 🙅

Yes, the tooltip for the expandable search should be using the [icon button](https://react.carbondesignsystem.com/?path=/story/components-iconbutton--default) tooltip size, not the larger one, so it matches others icon buttons in close proximity to it. 

This should be fixed in both React and Web Components. Web Components does not display a tooltip at all.

For this issue, we can update the tooltip for this component, and tackle the color/state inconsistencies I mentioned above separately.
Agree

So this means this section has to change:

https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon/blob/937649543e9cc6af9dfb6b53a2adb76760bca986/packages/react/src/components/Search/Search.tsx#L251-L283

issue.body: > [!NOTE] > Let's work on this issue once the code has been updated with this change. [#21569](https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon/issues/21569) ---- ## Detailed description The Search component is missing interactive states and is displaying the Clear icon button altho it shouldn't be visible the component is empty. > What version of the Carbon Design System library are you using? (v11) All themes - Carbon Design System > Is this issue related to a specific component? If so please give the page, frame, or layer/component name. Search > What did you expect to happen? What happened instead? What would you like to see changed? **Expanded state** Missing interactive states: - Hover + Filled - Focus + Empty I expect a property `Filled`: `True`/`False` on the search component similar to other input fields like for example Text area. I'd expect the fluid search to follow this pattern. Additionally, I don't expect the Clear icon button to be visible while the expanded search is disabled. **Collapsed state (Search icon button)** Missing interactive states: - Active - Focus - Disabled I expect to be able to set the collapsed search to the same states as other icon buttons. **Expanded state (Clear icon button)** Missing interactive states: - Any (Enabled, Hover, Active, Focus) I expect to be able set the Clear icon button to any interactive state (except for disabled) similar to other icon buttons. > Is this issue being filed based on a discrepancy between the website, code, and the kit? If so what is the inconsistency? In the design kit, the clear icon button is visible in the disabled state altho it shouldn't be. Missing interactive states makes it impossible to depict needed interactive states in product UI. > What offering/product do you work on? Any pressing ship or release dates we should be aware of? IBM Knowledge Catalog No pressing ship or release date. ## Steps to reproduce the issue Use the variant property `State` of the Search component. ## Additional information **Expanded state** As-is To-be **Search icon button & Clear icon button** As-is To-be

items.body:
I was looking at this recently too with our inconsistent use of tooltips on interactive states on icon-buttons that are placed inside other components.

This brings up a question I have for the devs around what color tokens we are using for these instances of the icon button, since they are placed on a `$field` input background. Would our layering logic work for these buttons, if this input for example was using `$field-02`? Need to investigate this more. I feel like we might need a `$field-active` color token if we are applying field tokens for the icon button that sits on inputs so it will work in different layering situations.

[Bug]: Expandable search has inconsistent tooltips on icon buttons

### Package @carbon/react ### Browser _No response_ ### Package version v1.101.0 ### Description Tooltips on the expandable search are not consistent with tooltips on other icon-only buttons. Tooltips on Search and Clear icon button: Tooltip on other icon buttons: Proposal: ### Screenshots ![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1658af32-5c89-497f-a9ea-2e0136077910) ### Steps to reproduce Interact with the expandable search component in the react storybook: https://react.carbondesignsystem.com/?path=/story/components-search--expandable ### Code of Conduct - [x] I agree to follow this project's [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon/blob/f555616971a03fd454c0f4daea184adf41fff05b/.github/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) - [x] I checked the [current issues](https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon/issues) for duplicate problems

I was looking at this recently too with our inconsistent use of tooltips on interactive states on icon-buttons that are placed inside other components.

This brings up a question I have for the devs around what color tokens we are using for these instances of the icon button, since they are placed on a `$field` input background. Would our layering logic work for these buttons, if this input for example was using `$field-02`? Need to investigate this more. I feel like we might need a `$field-active` color token if we are applying field tokens for the icon button that sits on inputs so it will work in different layering situations.
Just went through our UIs and found this to be a really bad UX. Check this out: 🙅

Yes, the tooltip for the expandable search should be using the [icon button](https://react.carbondesignsystem.com/?path=/story/components-iconbutton--default) tooltip size, not the larger one, so it matches others icon buttons in close proximity to it. 

This should be fixed in both React and Web Components. Web Components does not display a tooltip at all.

For this issue, we can update the tooltip for this component, and tackle the color/state inconsistencies I mentioned above separately.

So this means this section has to change:

https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon/blob/937649543e9cc6af9dfb6b53a2adb76760bca986/packages/react/src/components/Search/Search.tsx#L251-L283

     const magnifierWithTooltip =

         <Tooltip
-          className={`${prefix}--search-tooltip ${prefix}--search-magnifier-tooltip`}
+          className={`${prefix}--search-tooltip ${prefix}--search-magnifier-tooltip ${prefix}--icon-tooltip`}
